title: Configurable Data Residency SKU + Retention Add-on (CSQ / SCC mapping pilot)
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Enterprise prospects and existing customers in regulated industries are requesting more granular control in contracts and billing for data residency, subprocessor transparency, and retention. Current DPA tiers (default=hosted global, opt-in=EU-only with manual addendum) are inflexible for customers who need: shorter retention windows, explicit subprocessor whitelists, and an automated mapping of SCCs/UK Addendum status into contract templates and SKUs.

Goal: Ship a pilot that introduces a configurable Residency SKU offering (three initial options) plus a paid retention add-on that can be attached to enterprise orders and surfaced in the Console/CSQ flows. The pilot covers EU/UK SCC mapping automation, a subprocessor attestation checkbox + list, and a migration path for midsize customers to self-serve upgrades.

Scope (MVP):
- Residency SKU options: "Local EU" (data stored in EU region, standard 90d retention), "EU-Strict" (EU-only, 30d retention, signer-level attestation), "Global-Resilient" (multi-region, 365d retention).
- Paid retention add-on that allows customers to select 30/90/365/ever for hosted logs and prompts for applicable SKUs.
- CSQ flow updates: capture subprocessor exceptions, flag SCC/UK Addendum acceptance, and generate a PDF summary for Legal.
- Contract automation: DPA generator that pre-populates SCC mapping and retention choices into an addendum for review.
- Billing: create SKU metadata that maps residency+retention choices to pricing multiplier and billing code.

Out-of-scope (for this pilot): On-prem installation packaging, HSM/KMS integration changes, and network egress attestations.

Success metrics:
- 20 pilot customers configured in first 8 weeks
- 95% CSQ submission completeness rate for pilot customers
- No more than 2 legal follow-ups required per pilot contract (automation target)

Risks & mitigations:
- Legal review backlog: we pre-signed two template addenda drafts with Legal and Compliance prior to pilot launch.
- Billing SKU mismatch: finance will gate-migrate using a reconciliation script; initial orders must be approved by finance.
- Customer confusion on UI: include a short, contextual help text and link to a one-page explainer PDF.

Rollout plan:
- Week 0: internal legal review & DPA templates (done)
- Week 1-2: implement backend SKU mapping + CSQ API changes
- Week 3: Console UI + PDF generation + pilot onboarding docs
- Week 4: Activate pilot for ~10 customers, iterate on workflow

Notes for engineering: ensure residency selection is advisory at time of API routing (we do not change model variant selection), but must lock retention settings for logs artifacts in the storage layer.
